scripts.dev:fresh: bun run clean:cache && bun run policies:sync && astro dev
scripts.policies:update: git submodule update --remote vendor/policies && bun run policies:sync
scripts.cf:preview: bun run build && wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-10-01
scripts.cf:deploy: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "$CF_PAGES_PROJECT" --branch main
scripts.cf:deploy:preview: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "$CF_PAGES_PROJECT" --branch preview
